displayName: Citrus draft engine: ERROR log rate (3+ in 5 min)

documentation.content:
**What it means.** The draft engine container logged three or more `severity: ERROR` structured lines inside a 5-minute window. A healthy engine logs zero ERROR lines; every ERROR emit in `server/src/draft/` is a real failure (RPC failure, subscription fetch/apply failure, snapshot build failure, orphan-scan failure, uWS listen failure...). The threshold is 3 rather than 1 so a single retried blip on a Supabase hiccup does not email at 3 am; a sustained loop (e.g. the 16-hour `connect ECONNREFUSED` of 2026-08-19) trips it within one window.

**What to do.**
1. Pull the lines (the `event` field names the failing path):
   `gcloud logging read '(jsonPayload.container.metadata.app="citrus-draft-engine") AND jsonPayload.message:"\"severity\":\"ERROR\""' --project=citrus-fantasy-prod --freshness=30m --limit=50 --order=desc --format='value(jsonPayload.message)'`
2. Map the event to the runbook: `event_subscription.*` -> `docs/RUNBOOKS/draft-engine-v2-operations.md` section 2.13 / 5; `snapshot.*` -> section 6; `registry.*` / `uws.*` -> section 2.1; pick-path RPC errors -> section 2.2 / 2.3; `autopick.*` -> section 2.5.
3. If a deploy landed in the last hour, compare against `deployment.fingerprint` and consider the rollback playbook (`docs/RUNBOOKS/draft-engine-v2-rollback-playbook.md`).

Managed by `infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-monitoring.sh` (`alert-engine-errors.json`).
